crossRefs.note: The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Eshtaol
people.line: City allotted to Judah and Dan; associated with Samson

people.name: Zorah
people.line: A town in the Shephelah, home of Samson

translations.web: The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.
translations.bsb: So six hundred Danites departed from Zorah and Eshtaol, armed with weapons of war.
translations.kjv: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.
translations.asv: And there set forth from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men girt with weapons of war.
